feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: Follow NPR National News for reporting across the United States. Explore coverage of economic affordability, immigration, climate, environmental policy, justice and social trends.

entry.title: Despite concerns, the Trump administration still sends pregnant migrant minors to south Texas
entry.summary: Several children have had to leave the state to receive medical care, including abortions, that is unavailable in Texas.

entry.title: Judge orders an inquiry into potential DOJ misconduct in Trump's golf course case
entry.summary: A federal judge is opening an formal inquiry into Trump officials' conduct in the East Potomac case, including whether they misled the court about their plans for the municipal golf course.

entry.title: ICE activity is surging ahead of midterms. So is voter turnout.
entry.summary: Across the country, there are reports of heightened ICE activity. Advocates worry about how close it is to midterms, but so far voter turnout is surging.

entry.title: Why is the Cheesecake Factory at the center of the latest culture war?
entry.summary: A joke by former President Obama has gone viral and received backlash from the Trump administration as the issue of affordability looms large over next week's midterm elections.

entry.title: On what anatomical feature was Trump fixated this week? The quiz knows — do you?
entry.summary: Hint: He likes them big (and he cannot lie).

entry.title: 'Affordability? For who?' Voters decide between helping homeowners or public services
entry.summary: Candidates across the U.S. have paid lip service to affordability issues. In Florida, the question of how to save voters money, and at what cost, is literally on the ballot.

entry.title: For voters from immigrant families and new citizens, voting is bigger than themselves
entry.summary: While many young voters are focused on the cost of living in the election, for some from immigrant families, the political calculation — and their votes — is often about even more than the economy.

entry.title: Here are the Senate races to watch ahead of Election Day
entry.summary: The competitive map for control of the U.S. Senate has expanded considerably in the final days before Election Day. Here's a ranking of those competitive races from most likely to flip to least likely.

entry.title: 2026 midterm election voter guides: Find local resources in your community
entry.summary: NPR member stations are gathering information for voters — from voter guides down to local races. Scroll through to find your state and the resources available from your local member station.

entry.title: How powerful is Elon Musk? How his political influence compares to past U.S. moguls
entry.summary: Critics say the tech entrepreneur's enormous wealth has given him too much political power. But when stacked up against other notable American moguls, historians say he's not unique.
